messages:
maria: FYI observed a cluster of SSE clients in eu region getting stuck after probe RTT spikes. clients hit our shepherd backoff and then fail to rejoin because reconnects keep landing on same hot pool.

Tess: is this SSE-only? any websocket reports?

maria: mostly SSE, very few WS. logs show keepalive -> probe RTT ~850-1200ms -> shepherd backoff -> reconnect chosen pool util >90%. no 4xx, just timeouts and then client gives up.

samuel: sounds like sticky affinity is amplifying it. if reconnects prefer the same pool we keep slamming a saturated host. we should allow one affinity-break retry within the shepherd window.

kai: agree. propose feature flag: "relaxed_rejoin_affinity" that on probe-triggered reconnects prefers lower-util pools for first N attempts. roll at 5%-10% then expand.

Tess: visibility gaps: probe events are sampled at 1% by default. during canary we had almost no probe telemetry. need console control to bump probe_sampling for SREs.

maria: also can we tag disconnects with cause=probe so quota/billing and dashboard alerts can separate them? currently they look like user disconnect storms.

samuel: quick config tweak: bump shepherd_threshold_ms to 800 in eu for the canary and add small randomized jitter to backoff. I'll open a PR with: threshold bump, jitter, and flag.

kai: add a metric shepherd.probe_trips_per_pool so we can quickly identify bad pools (eu-pool-3 is suspicious in the logs).

deploy-bot: rollout request accepted. plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m observation windows. telemetry tag: sse.probe-relax-canary.

Tess: minor UX ask: expose probe_sampling_rate on Console (SRE write) and add a dashboard filter for disconnect_cause=probe.

maria: thanks. will link PR and open an incident doc for postmortem items.

samuel: adding alert tweak: silence reconnect-rate pages for eu for 20m during rollout, but keep an adhoc panel for probe vs user disconnects.

kai: after canary, let's run a controlled failover of suspected pools and observe probe_trips. if metric still high, evict pool from routing.

maria: good plan. i'll start the PR and ticket chain.
